capability.summary: List local Git tag names with direct object IDs and creator-date text in a fixed tab-separated format
capability.description: Runs `git tag -l` with a fixed refname/objectname/creatordate format for one repository. It returns raw text, does not peel annotated tags to commits, and performs no fetch, verification, creation, or deletion.
capability.problem_space: Read-only inventory of locally present Git refs/tags in one fixed text format; not release discovery from remotes, peeled commit resolution, signature validation, semantic-version analysis, or tag mutation.

constraint.io_signature: Input: one required existing Git repository path; output: JSON process envelope whose stdout contains tab-separated local tag name, direct short object ID, and creator date lines.
accepted_inputs: an existing local Git repository directory whose currently available tags should be listed
constraint.output_shape: Success: {status: "success", tool: "git", target: string, exit_code: 0, result: null, stdout: string, stderr: string|null}; each stdout line is `<tag name>\t<direct short object ID>\t<creator date ISO text>`. Nonzero Git result uses the same keys with status="tool_error" and propagates Git's exit code. Non-existing path, missing executable, or 120-second timeout: {status: "error", tool: "git", message: string}, exiting 2/3/4. Missing argument prints usage to stderr and exits 1 without JSON.
limitations: returns unparsed tab-separated stdout with result=null and does not identify whether each tag is lightweight or annotated
`%(objectname:short)` is the direct ref target and can be an annotated tag object rather than the peeled commit
lists only locally available tags with Git's default ordering; it does not fetch remotes, inspect messages, verify signatures, or analyze semantic versions
uses a fixed 120-second timeout, captures output without truncation, and never creates, moves, pushes, or deletes tags

output_contract.description: JSON execution envelope whose stdout contains fixed tab-separated local tag names, direct short object IDs, and creator dates.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.

intent_tags: list locally available Git tags with object IDs
inspect Git tag names and creator dates as text
negative_intents: create delete move push or fetch Git tags
resolve annotated tags to peeled commits or verify signatures
inspect Git branches logs diffs or releases from a remote service
